question: In a certain code language, 'SUM’ is coded as '212519' and 'NET' is coded as '16926'. How will 'MOP' be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'SUM’ is coded as '212519',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2f01a6f5d72fe6fea81160849ff263e58c4337aafdc498468d4bdb8baaeff4e.png] 

'NET' is coded as '16926',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dafa4dfae823f733bf0276984a48e523d23a7568f9d176ad09ea823f7731a507.png] 

Similarly, for '**MOP**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eab8bba29229b3dd83df56a5ae567d94183d436421ac270177ecb154cd4ee460.png] 

So, 'MOP' will be coded as '**151922**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
